import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_2.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN Source3_27_0 and Source3_27_1 on user_id
df01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', on='user_id')

# 2) JOIN the result with Source3_27_2 on movie_id
df_final = pd.merge(df01, df2, how='inner', on='movie_id')

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema: ['title': string, 'user_id': float, 'movie_id': integer, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': float, 'age': float, 'occupation': float]

# Convert columns to required types:
# title: string (already string)
# user_id: float
df_final['user_id'] = df_final['user_id'].astype(float)
# movie_id: integer
df_final['movie_id'] = df_final['movie_id'].astype(int)
# rating: float
df_final['rating'] = df_final['rating'].astype(float)
# timestamp: float
df_final['timestamp'] = df_final['timestamp'].astype(float)
# age: float
df_final['age'] = df_final['age'].astype(float)
# occupation: float
df_final['occupation'] = df_final['occupation'].astype(float)

# Extract only the needed columns in the correct order
target_df = df_final[['title', 'user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'age', 'occupation']]

# Write the result to the specified path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_27_0 and Source3_27_1 on user_id (inner join)
joined_01 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="user_id", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_27_2 on movie_id (inner join)
joined_all = pd.merge(joined_01, source2, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema: title (string), user_id (float but used as group key), movie_id (int)
# Aggregate other columns by mean as they are float and numeric
grouped = joined_all.groupby(["title", "user_id", "movie_id"], as_index=False).agg({
    "rating": "mean",
    "timestamp": "mean",
    "age": "mean",
    "occupation": "mean"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
final_df = grouped[["title", "user_id", "movie_id", "rating", "timestamp", "age", "occupation"]]

# Write output to the specified path
final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_27/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
